## Card-quality checklist

<!-- Remove or leave unchecked any item that is not applicable. -->

- [ ] Wording is original and does not reproduce protected course material
- [ ] New facts use `status: draft` until independently reviewed
- [ ] Released card IDs were not renamed or reused
- [ ] The question is understandable without relying on the previous card
- [ ] Distractors are plausible, belong to the same class and do not reveal the answer
- [ ] The correct choice is not visibly longer or more detailed than every distractor
- [ ] The explanation adds reasoning or context instead of only repeating the answer
- [ ] English and French have the same choice count and correct-choice index
- [ ] French reads naturally and uses appropriate wine terminology
